scene_setting: A cluttered, sunlit apartment living room with scattered snacks, a half-empty soda can, and a TV playing a muted cartoon. The air feels thick with casual laziness, punctuated by sudden, comically exaggerated bodily sounds.

subjects.descriptor: A middle-aged man slumped on a worn sofa, wearing rumpled pajamas, eyes half-closed, one hand resting on his bloated stomach.
A teenage girl in a hoodie, standing near the kitchen doorway, holding a smartphone, her face frozen in a mix of disgust and stifled laughter.

shots.scene_setting: The man (S1) is sprawled on the sofa, eyes closed, one hand rubbing his stomach. The girl (S2) stands frozen in the doorway, phone lowered, mouth slightly open in shock. The cartoon on TV emits muffled squeaks and boings.
shots.primary_action: S1 lets out a loud, prolonged fart while dozing.

shots.scene_setting: S1 slowly opens one eye, looking sheepish. S2 lowers her phone completely, a smirk spreading across her face as she shakes her head. She lets out a soft snicker and a sharp tongue-click, her eyes locked on S1.
shots.primary_action: S2 reacts with audible amusement to S1's fart.

scene_setting: A dimly lit 18th-century parlor with velvet drapes, candlelight flickering on mahogany furniture. Two figures in period attire sit across from each other: one mid-laugh, the other mid-sigh — both visible, faces expressive. The air is still, no ambient noise, only their vocalizations.

subjects.descriptor: a young woman in a silk gown, seated on a chaise, laughing with head tilted back
an older man in a powdered wig, leaning forward with a weary sigh

primary_action: A woman performs a sharp tongue-click while laughing, seated opposite a sighing man in a candlelit parlor.

scene_setting: A candlelit 19th-century parlor with heavy velvet drapes, mahogany furniture, and a faint scent of lavender. The atmosphere is tense and intimate, with soft shadows playing across the walls.

subjects.descriptor: A middle-aged woman in a high-necked lace gown, seated rigidly on a chaise longue, her face pale and eyes wide with suppressed emotion
A young man in a waistcoat and cravat, standing by the fireplace, hands clenched at his sides, face flushed with frustration

shots.scene_setting: The woman (S1) sits frozen on the chaise, her hands gripping the fabric, eyes fixed on the floor. The man (S2) stands near the fireplace, his back to her, shoulders tense. The room is silent except for the crackle of the fire.
shots.primary_action: S1 trembles subtly; S2 stares into the fire

shots.scene_setting: S2 turns sharply toward S1, his expression anguished. S1 flinches but does not look up. A single tear rolls down her cheek as she lets out a barely audible sigh.
shots.primary_action: S2 confronts S1; S1 cries silently

shots.scene_setting: S1 slowly lifts her head, eyes red-rimmed, and looks directly at S2. Her moan grows louder, trembling with emotion. S2 steps back, hand covering his mouth, visibly shaken.
shots.primary_action: S1 confronts S2 with emotional intensity; S2 recoils

The only visible subject is a trembling stray cat huddled under a dumpster, its fur matted and eyes wide. The sound of heavy, choked crying echoes from off-screen — raw, guttural, and sustained — while faint distant sirens and dripping water provide ambient texture.

subjects.descriptor: an off-screen crying person
a wet stray cat

scene_setting: A realistic 3D-animated sequence showing a human protagonist reacting to sudden illness in a domestic interior, transitioning from comfort to distress to recovery, with ambient household sounds and a background radio playing instrumental music.

subjects.descriptor: a middle-aged man in casual home clothes, visibly unwell

shots.scene_setting: Living room, afternoon. S1 sits on a sofa, looking tired but calm, holding a tissue. A radio plays soft instrumental music in the background. He suddenly coughs once, sharply.
Same room. S1 is now standing, leaning forward slightly, one hand on his chest. He coughs twice in quick succession, eyes watering. The radio music continues softly.
Same room. S1 is now doubled over, coughing intensely, face red. A glass of water on the side table rattles slightly with each cough. The radio music fades out briefly.
Same room. S1 sits back on the sofa, breathing heavily but calming down. He takes a sip of water. The radio resumes playing instrumental music. He gives a weak sigh.

scene_setting: A dimly lit hospital hallway at night, with flickering fluorescent lights and a distant echo of a monitor beeping. The camera slowly dollies in toward a closed door with a small window, through which a faint silhouette is visible. Outside the frame, a woman’s scream pierces the silence — raw, panicked, and unmistakably human — followed by a muffled thud. A nurse’s station sign glows softly in the background.

subjects.descriptor: an off-screen woman

primary_action: off-screen scream followed by silence

scene_setting: A dimly lit 18th-century study, candlelight flickering on wooden bookshelves and a heavy oak desk; the air is thick with the scent of aged parchment and beeswax. The camera follows a single human subject seated at the desk, their face illuminated in profile as they struggle to stay awake while reading.

subjects.descriptor: A middle-aged male scholar in period waistcoat and cravat, slumped over an open folio, eyes heavy with fatigue.

shots.scene_setting: The scholar sits upright at the desk, quill poised above parchment. His eyelids flutter as he forces himself to focus on the text. A single candle casts long shadows across his face.
He leans forward, resting his forehead on his hand. His breathing slows. The candle flame wavers as he drifts, eyes half-closed, lips parted slightly.
His head jerks upright with a gasp — a full, deep yawn escapes him, jaw stretching wide. His spectacles slip down his nose. The quill clatters onto the desk.
He slumps back in the chair, eyes closed, one hand rubbing his temple. The candlelight dances across his face. He exhales slowly, a quiet sigh escaping him.
He opens his eyes, blinking rapidly. He adjusts his spectacles, picks up the quill, and forces himself to write another line. His hand trembles slightly. The candle sputters — nearly burnt out.

scene_setting: A dimly lit, slightly cluttered apartment living room at dusk. The camera slowly dollies out from a close-up of a young woman’s face as she sniffs audibly — her nose twitching, eyes watering slightly, cheeks flushed. Behind her, a man in his 40s is visible in the background, coughing into his elbow while scrolling on his phone. The faint hum of a refrigerator and distant city traffic are audible, contributing to the layered audio environment.

subjects.descriptor: a young woman with flushed cheeks and watery eyes, visibly sniffing
a middle-aged man in a t-shirt, coughing into his elbow while seated on a couch

scene_setting: A handheld vlog-style sequence set in a neon-drenched cyberpunk alleyway at night, featuring a young human protagonist reacting to ambient digital glitches and flickering holograms. The entire audio track consists solely of non-verbal vocalizations from the protagonist and a second visible human companion — no background music, no environmental sounds, no off-screen sources. Visuals emphasize glowing interfaces, reflective puddles, and chrome-plated street furniture under pulsing magenta and cyan lights.

subjects.descriptor: a young female hacker in a glowing cybernetic jacket, face partially obscured by AR visor
a middle-aged male tech-savant with exposed neural ports and a cracked visor

shots.scene_setting: Close-up on S1’s face under flickering neon, AR visor glitching as she smirks and lets out a sharp smirk-laugh. Behind her, S2 adjusts his cracked visor with a sniffle. Chrome pipes reflect magenta light onto wet pavement.
shots.primary_action: S1 smirks and laughs sharply while AR visor glitches

shots.scene_setting: Medium shot of S1 turning to S2, clicking her tongue twice in rhythm as holographic code scrolls across her gloves. S2 sighs deeply, shoulders slumping under his trench coat. Neon signs cast shifting cyan shadows.
shots.primary_action: S1 clicks tongue rhythmically while displaying holographic code

shots.scene_setting: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind S2, showing S1’s reflection in a rain-slicked chrome wall as she smirks again and laughs — same smirk-laugh as Shot 1. Her cybernetic eye glints under pulsing magenta light. S2’s neural ports flicker in sync with the laugh.
shots.primary_action: S1 smirks and laughs again, reflected in chrome wall

shots.scene_setting: Low-angle wide shot of both subjects standing under a broken holographic billboard. S1 smirks and lets out another smirk-laugh as S2 exhales sharply. Rain drips from overhead wires onto their glowing jackets. No other sounds or movement.
shots.primary_action: S1 laughs smugly under broken holographic billboard

shots.scene_setting: Close-up on S2’s face as he sighs again, eyes closed, neural ports pulsing. Behind him, S1 smirks and lets out a final smirk-laugh — softer this time, almost teasing. Holographic glyphs float around her like digital fireflies.
shots.primary_action: S2 sighs while S1 delivers final smirk-laugh

shots.scene_setting: Handheld follow shot from behind S1 as she walks away down the alley, shoulders shaking with one last smirk-laugh. S2 watches from behind, visor flickering. Neon lights blur into streaks as the camera pans up to a glitching sky.
shots.primary_action: S1 walks away laughing smugly, camera follows from behind

scene_setting: A crowded city park at dusk, with soft golden-hour lighting. Two teenagers are visible: one sitting on a bench laughing loudly, the other standing nearby clapping hands. In the background, a street musician plays an acoustic guitar (instrument L1) while birds chirp faintly (ambient L1). A small dog barks off-screen (animal L1).

subjects.descriptor: Teenage girl with curly hair, wearing a denim jacket, sitting on a park bench
Teenage boy with glasses, wearing a striped hoodie, standing beside the bench

scene_setting: A neon-drenched cyberpunk alleyway at night, rain-slicked pavement reflecting holographic ads, with a lone human figure in a reflective trench coat performing rhythmic vocal percussion under a flickering streetlamp.

subjects.descriptor: A young male street performer with cybernetic ear implants, wearing a glowing circuit-patterned hoodie under a raincoat, standing under a flickering neon sign.
A middle-aged female bystander in a transparent rain poncho, holding a glowing umbrella, watching from across the alley with a curious expression.

shots.scene_setting: Close-up on S1’s face, rain dripping from his cybernetic ear implants as he begins a complex beatbox rhythm, eyes closed in concentration.
Medium shot of S1 from the waist up, hands moving in sync with his vocal percussion, neon reflections dancing on his raincoat.
Wide shot revealing S2 standing across the alley, glowing umbrella in hand, head tilted as she listens intently to S1’s beatboxing.
Close-up on S2’s face — her expression shifts from curiosity to delight as S1’s beatboxing intensifies, mouth slightly open in awe.
Low-angle shot of S1 from behind, rain falling in slow motion as he throws his head back mid-beat, neon lights casting sharp shadows on his coat.
Two-shot: S1 and S2 now face each other across the alley, S2 clapping rhythmically along with the beat, S1 nodding in acknowledgment.
Wide shot fading out: S1 finishes his beatbox loop with a final punchy sound, S2 applauds, neon signs flicker and dim as rain continues to fall.

scene_setting: A handheld vlog shot from inside a cozy apartment living room at dusk. Warm lamplight illuminates a cluttered coffee table with mugs and books. Outside the window, faint city traffic hums and distant sirens wail. A soft piano melody plays from a speaker off-frame to the right. The camera is static, aimed slightly downward at the table, capturing only the ambient environment — no human faces or bodies visible.

subjects.descriptor: an off-screen narrator

primary_action: off-screen laughter and sneezing

scene_setting: A dimly lit, realistic bedroom at night; heavy rain taps against the window, but no ambient sound is present — only the dominant snoring and secondary non-verbal vocalizations from the human subject. The room is minimally furnished with a wooden bed, nightstand, and a single lamp casting warm light.

subjects.descriptor: A middle-aged male sleeping soundly on his back, mouth slightly open, wearing a cotton t-shirt
A teenage female lying awake beside him, eyes open, occasionally shifting under the blanket

primary_action: S1 snores rhythmically while S2 reacts with sighs and sniffles

shots.scene_setting: S1 lies on his back in bed, snoring loudly. S2 lies beside him, eyes wide open, staring at the ceiling. Rain streaks the window behind them. The camera tracks slowly from left to right, revealing the full bed.
Close-up on S1’s face: mouth open, chest rising and falling with each snore. The camera tracks slightly upward to catch his eyelids fluttering. S2’s hand enters frame, reaching toward the nightstand.
shots.primary_action: S1 snores; S2 reaches for nightstand

shots.scene_setting: S2’s hand picks up a glass of water from the nightstand. The camera tracks her hand as she lifts it, then pans to her face — she takes a quiet sip, eyes still fixed on S1. Rain continues outside.
shots.primary_action: S2 drinks water while watching S1

shots.scene_setting: S2 places the glass back on the nightstand. The camera tracks her arm downward, then tilts to show S1’s chest still heaving. S2 pulls the blanket tighter around herself, shivering slightly.
shots.primary_action: S2 covers herself; S1 continues snoring

shots.scene_setting: S2 turns onto her side, facing away from S1. The camera tracks her movement, then lingers on S1’s face — his snore deepens, becoming more rhythmic. The lamp flickers once.
shots.primary_action: S2 turns away; S1’s snore deepens

shots.scene_setting: S2 suddenly sits up, startled. The camera tracks her upward motion. S1 remains asleep, snoring. She rubs her eyes, then glances at the window — rain still falls. She sighs again, louder this time.
shots.primary_action: S2 sits up startled; S1 continues snoring

shots.scene_setting: S2 gets out of bed, bare feet padding softly on the wooden floor. The camera tracks her movement toward the door. S1 stirs slightly in his sleep but doesn’t wake. She pauses at the doorframe, looking back at him.
shots.primary_action: S2 gets out of bed; S1 stirs

shots.scene_setting: S2 stands in the doorway, silhouetted against the hallway light. The camera tracks slowly toward her, then pans back to S1 — still snoring, undisturbed. The rain outside fades into silence as the scene ends.
shots.primary_action: S2 stands in doorway; S1 continues snoring

scene_setting: A moonlit elven glade in a mystical forest, glowing mushrooms line the path, and faint bioluminescent mist swirls around ancient stone arches. A young human female with silver-veined skin and pointed ears stands center frame, eyes closed, hands clasped as if in ritual. Behind her, a translucent spirit-like figure hovers silently, emitting a low hum. The air thrums with ambient magic and distant chimes.

subjects.descriptor: A young female elf with silver-veined skin, pointed ears, and glowing green eyes, wearing a flowing robe woven from living vines
A translucent spirit figure hovering behind the elf, emitting a low resonant hum

primary_action: The elf gasps and hiccups mid-ritual, eyes snapping open in surprise, as the spirit behind her hums in response.

scene_setting: A handheld vlog-style sequence following a young adult woman in a cozy, cluttered apartment living room as she experiences a sudden sneeze attack — the dominant sound is a loud, wet sneeze that triggers a cascade of secondary sounds including a falling book, a startled cat yowl, and a microwave beeping in the background. The lighting is natural daylight from a window, with soft shadows and realistic textures on furniture, fabrics, and skin.

subjects.descriptor: a young woman in casual home clothes, mid-sneeze with eyes shut and nose scrunched

primary_action: sneezing uncontrollably while trying to hold back

shots.scene_setting: Handheld medium close-up of S1 sitting on a couch, eyes watering, nose twitching. Sunlight streams through the window behind her. A cat curls on the armrest. She sniffs loudly.
S1 leans forward, eyes squeezed shut, hand covering mouth. The cat flinches. A book on the side table wobbles slightly.
S1’s head jerks back violently as she sneezes. The book falls off the table with a thud. The cat jumps off the couch.
S1 gasps for air, wiping her nose. The cat yowls from the floor. In the background, the microwave beeps twice.
shots.primary_action: recovering from sneeze, reacting to cat

shots.scene_setting: S1 stands up, rubbing her nose, looking toward the kitchen. The microwave beeps again. She takes a step, then stops, eyes widening as another sneeze builds.
Close-up of S1’s face as she sneezes again — eyes shut, nose scrunched, head jerking forward. The microwave beeps in sync with the sneeze.
S1 stumbles backward, catching herself on the couch. She sniffs again, eyes watery. The cat watches from a distance. A tissue box sits on the coffee table.
S1 grabs a tissue, blows her nose loudly. She looks exhausted but relieved. The microwave beeps one last time. The cat curls up again on the armrest.
S1 sits back on the couch, tissue in hand, eyes half-closed. She lets out a final soft sniffle. The room is quiet except for the faint hum of the microwave cooling down. She smiles faintly.

scene_setting: A dimly lit, cluttered living room at dusk; soft ambient hum from an old refrigerator and faint distant city traffic audible. subjects.descriptor: A young woman in casual home clothes, visibly tense, standing near a window
subjects.primary_action: whistling sharply while looking toward the hallway

subjects.descriptor: an off-screen male voice

primary_action: whistling sharply while looking toward the hallway

scene_setting: A dimly lit, slightly cluttered living room at dusk, with rain streaking the windowpane and a faint hum of a refrigerator in the background. The atmosphere is heavy with unspoken tension.

subjects.descriptor: A middle-aged woman sitting rigidly on a worn sofa, clutching a crumpled tissue, eyes fixed on a closed bedroom door.
A teenage boy pacing nervously near the kitchen counter, occasionally glancing toward the living room.

shots.scene_setting: The woman (S1) sits motionless on the sofa, rain visible through the window behind her. Her shoulders slump slightly as she lets out a long, audible sigh. The camera slowly follows her gaze toward the closed bedroom door.
shots.primary_action: S1 sighs deeply while staring at the bedroom door.

shots.scene_setting: The camera cuts to the teenage boy (S2) pacing near the kitchen counter, his face tense. He pauses, looks toward the living room, and exhales sharply — a heavy sigh — before turning back to the counter. Rain still streaks the window in the background.
shots.primary_action: S2 sighs audibly while pacing, then stops and looks toward the living room.

He’s trying not to cry. Again.

subjects.descriptor: an off-screen vocalizer

scene_setting: A handheld vlog-style sequence following a young woman in a quiet urban park during golden hour, transitioning from a bench to a path to a small bridge — all while capturing her expressive non-verbal vocalizations and interactions with a nearby child. subjects.descriptor: A young woman in casual streetwear, sitting on a park bench, visibly amused and animated

subjects.descriptor: A small child in bright clothes, running toward the woman with a toy airplane

shots.scene_setting: Handheld medium shot tracking a young woman sitting on a park bench, sunlight filtering through trees. She’s smiling and making a series of playful tongue-click sounds toward a child running into frame. Background: distant city traffic hum and bird chirps.
shots.primary_action: Woman making tongue-click sounds while watching child approach

shots.scene_setting: Tracking medium shot following the woman as she stands and walks along a paved path, still making tongue-click sounds. The child runs ahead, laughing loudly. Background: rustling leaves and distant construction noise.
shots.primary_action: Woman walking and continuing tongue-clicking while child runs ahead

shots.scene_setting: Tracking medium shot as the woman and child reach a small wooden bridge. The woman suddenly sneezes mid-tongue-click, then laughs. Child mimics her sneeze and laughs louder. Background: flowing stream and faint car engine.
shots.primary_action: Woman sneezes mid-tongue-click, child mimics and laughs

scene_setting: A melancholic fantasy forest clearing at twilight, where glowing mushrooms pulse softly and ancient trees whisper with sentient wind. A lone human figure kneels in the center, surrounded by spectral figures that flicker in and out of visibility — their forms half-real, half-illusion. The air hums with ambient magic and distant, echoing chimes. The dominant sound is a human cry, raw and trembling, layered with faint whispers from the spirits and the rustle of unseen wings.

subjects.descriptor: A young woman in tattered elven robes, her face streaked with tears, kneeling on mossy stone
A translucent spirit with flowing robes, hovering behind the woman, hands outstretched as if trying to comfort her

primary_action: The woman cries uncontrollably as the spirit hovers behind her, whispering soothing words that only she can hear.

shots.scene_setting: Twilight forest clearing. The woman kneels alone on mossy stone, head bowed. Glowing mushrooms pulse gently around her. A faint breeze stirs her hair. The spirit is not yet visible. The only sound is her soft, trembling cry.
shots.primary_action: The woman begins to cry, her shoulders shaking.

shots.scene_setting: The spirit materializes behind the woman, translucent and shimmering. She reaches out with glowing hands. The woman doesn’t turn, but her cry deepens. A faint whispering begins, layered beneath her sobs.
shots.primary_action: The spirit appears and begins whispering to the woman.

shots.scene_setting: The woman lifts her head slightly, tears streaming down her cheeks. The spirit’s hands hover inches from her shoulders. A gust of wind rustles the leaves, and a soft chime echoes from above. Her cry becomes more desperate, punctuated by gasps.
shots.primary_action: The woman’s cry intensifies as the spirit tries to comfort her.

shots.scene_setting: The spirit fades slightly, its glow dimming. The woman lowers her head again, her cry softening to a whimper. The mushrooms pulse slower. A single feather drifts down from the sky. The whispering fades, replaced by silence except for the faintest echo of her cry.
shots.primary_action: The woman’s cry subsides as the spirit begins to fade away.

scene_setting: A realistic 2D-animated living room during a quiet afternoon; sunlight filters through sheer curtains onto a worn sofa where a middle-aged woman sits reading, while a teenage boy in a hoodie stands nearby coughing loudly — the sound echoes slightly off the wooden floorboards. A small cat curls up on the windowsill, tail twitching in rhythm with the coughing. A digital clock on the wall reads 15:37. The boy’s cough is sharp and wet, followed by a sniffle. The woman looks up briefly, concerned, then returns to her book. The cat yawns silently.

subjects.descriptor: middle-aged woman reading a paperback novel
teenage boy in a hoodie, standing near the sofa
small tabby cat on windowsill

scene_setting: A tense, overcast afternoon in a cluttered urban apartment. Rain streaks the windows. The protagonist, a young woman, is visibly distressed — pacing, clutching her head, eyes wide. The atmosphere is thick with anxiety. A secondary character (an older man) is partially visible in the background, observing silently. The dominant sound is a piercing scream, layered with muffled sobs and distant thunder.

subjects.descriptor: a young woman in a rumpled sweater, face flushed with panic
an older man in a worn robe, standing still near the doorway

shots.scene_setting: The young woman stands frozen near the window, rain tapping the glass. Her breath is shallow. She glances at the older man in the doorway. The room feels suffocating. A low rumble of thunder begins.
She turns sharply, hands gripping the back of a chair. Her face contorts in fear. The older man takes a half-step forward, his expression unreadable. Thunder cracks louder.
She collapses to her knees, head bowed, shoulders shaking. The older man kneels beside her, placing a hand on her shoulder. Rain pours outside. The scream echoes faintly in the room.
She lifts her head, eyes red and swollen, staring blankly at the ceiling. The older man whispers something. The thunder fades. Her breathing slows. The scream lingers as a memory.
She stands slowly, wiping her face. The older man rises with her. They look at each other silently. The rain has stopped. The room is still. The scream is gone, replaced by quiet resolve.

subjects.descriptor: A young woman with messy hair and dark circles under her eyes, wearing a loose sweater, visibly exhausted
A middle-aged man in casual home attire, holding a coffee mug, watching the woman with mild concern

subjects.descriptor: A young woman in her early 20s, wearing a loose sweater, with flushed cheeks and watery eyes, visibly congested
A gray tabby cat napping on the windowsill

shots.scene_setting: Medium shot of the young woman (S1) slumped on the sofa, rubbing her nose with a tissue. Sunlight catches dust motes in the air. The cat (S2) is visible napping on the windowsill. A clock ticks softly in the background.
shots.primary_action: S1 sniffling while rubbing her nose

shots.scene_setting: Close-up on S1's face as she tries to suppress a sneeze, eyes squeezed shut, nose twitching. The cat (S2) stirs slightly on the windowsill. Distant traffic hum is audible.

shots.scene_setting: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind S1 as she looks out the window. Rain begins to patter against the glass. The cat (S2) watches the rain from its perch. S1 lets out a long sigh.
shots.primary_action: S1 looking out the window as rain starts

shots.scene_setting: Close-up on S1's hands as she folds a tissue, fingers trembling slightly. The cat (S2) jumps down from the windowsill and walks toward her. A soft purring sound is audible.
shots.primary_action: S1 folding a tissue with trembling hands

shots.scene_setting: Medium shot of S1 sitting back down on the sofa, the cat (S2) curling up beside her. She takes a deep, shaky breath and lets out one final, soft sniffle. The room is quiet except for the rain and the cat's purr.
shots.primary_action: S1 sitting with the cat, taking a deep breath

An off-screen street vendor shouting from a food cart

subjects.descriptor: A young adult male gamer in a hoodie, slumped in a gaming chair, face flushed with fatigue, then erupting into a wide, triumphant grin.

shots.scene_setting: Close-up on S1’s tired face, eyes half-closed, head nodding slightly. The hum of computers and faint keyboard taps fill the air. The room is dim, lit only by monitor glow.
shots.primary_action: S1 dozing off in gaming chair

shots.scene_setting: S1 jerks awake, eyes wide, fingers twitching over the keyboard. A monitor flashes with a victory screen. The ambient hum rises slightly. His hoodie sleeve slips down his wrist.
S1 throws his arms up, chair wheels screeching. His face contorts into a wide, ecstatic grin. A coffee cup rattles on the desk. The keyboard taps stop abruptly.
S1 leans forward, breathless, eyes glued to the monitor. His hoodie hood slips off, revealing messy hair. The ambient hum fades slightly as he whispers to himself.
shots.primary_action: S1 whispering to himself in disbelief

shots.scene_setting: S1 slumps back, exhaling loudly. His fingers tap rhythmically on the desk. The monitor flickers with a replay. A faint click echoes from the mouse.

shots.primary_action: S1 yawning and relaxing after victory

scene_setting: A dimly lit 2D animated underground club with concrete walls, exposed pipes, and flickering fluorescent lights. Close-up of S1’s face as two more rapid tongue clicks echo from off-screen. Her eyebrows furrow slightly; she bites her lower lip. The background is softly blurred, focusing on her micro-expression. A framed photo of a smiling couple is visible on a shelf behind her.

S1 turns her head sharply toward off-screen right, eyes narrowed. A third set of tongue clicks comes, faster and more insistent. She exhales audibly through her nose. The shot is framed slightly wider, showing her hands gripping the sofa cushion. A wall-mounted TV screen is off in the background.

S1 stands up abruptly, facing off-screen right. Her posture is tense, shoulders squared. Two more tongue clicks come — slower, deliberate. She closes her eyes for a beat, then opens them with a small, resigned smile. The camera is slightly lower, emphasizing her height and stance. A plant in a ceramic pot is visible near her feet.

S1 walks slowly toward the camera, passing the sofa. She looks directly at the lens, smiling faintly. A final, soft tongue click is heard. She raises her hand in a small wave. The background is now blurred, with only her face and upper body in focus. A framed poster on the wall reads 'Breathe. Listen. Respond.'
shots.primary_action: Walking toward camera with faint smile

scene_setting: A handheld vlog-style shot following a woman in period-accurate 18th-century European gown as she walks through a candlelit manor hallway. Her face is visible and expressive, her posture slightly hunched as if overwhelmed. The only audible sound is her moaning — low, breathy, and emotionally charged — synchronized with her facial tension and body jerk. No other sounds or sound sources are present or implied.

subjects.descriptor: A woman in a powdered wig and silk gown, visibly distressed, clutching her chest
A man in a tricorn hat and coat, standing still in the background, watching her with concern

primary_action: moaning while walking

scene_setting: A dystopian cyberpunk alleyway at night, neon signs flicker with holographic ads, rain-slicked pavement reflects the glow, a lone human figure huddles under a broken umbrella, their face illuminated by a passing hover-bike's headlights.

subjects.descriptor: A young female human in a tattered synth-leather jacket, face streaked with rain and tears, eyes wide with sorrow
A broken public comms terminal with sparking wires

shots.scene_setting: Close-up of S1’s face under flickering neon, tears mixing with rain, her cybernetic eye glowing blue as she begins to sob quietly.
S1 stumbles backward, knocking over a trash can; sparks fly from S2’s broken terminal nearby as she lets out a louder cry, her hand clutching her chest.
S1 collapses to her knees, head bowed, rain pouring down as her cry turns into a wail; the terminal’s sparks dim but continue to crackle softly.
S1 slowly lifts her head, eyes red but resolute, as a distant siren wails; she stands, brushing off rain, the terminal’s spark fading to silence.

scene_setting: A dimly lit, neon-drenched cyberpunk alleyway with flickering holographic signs and steam rising from grates. Two human figures stand under a flickering streetlamp: one in a high-collared synth-leather coat, the other in a glowing bio-luminescent bodysuit. The air hums with distant drone whirring and a low-frequency synth pulse from a hidden speaker. A sudden, sharp cough erupts from the figure in the synth-leather coat, followed by a muffled sigh from the glowing figure.

subjects.descriptor: A cyberpunk street hustler in a high-collared synth-leather coat
A bio-luminescent street performer in a glowing bodysuit

primary_action: A cyberpunk hustler suddenly coughs violently while standing next to a glowing street performer.

scene_setting: A tense, dimly lit apartment hallway at night; flickering overhead light casts long shadows, walls are cracked, floorboards creak underfoot. The air is thick with suspense as two figures move toward a closed door — one visibly trembling, the other poised to act.

subjects.descriptor: A teenage girl with wide, terrified eyes and disheveled hair, wearing a thin cotton nightgown, clutching a flashlight that shakes in her hand.
A middle-aged man in a stained bathrobe, barefoot, his face rigid with fear, one hand gripping the doorknob, the other raised as if to shield himself.

primary_action: The girl screams in terror as the man recoils from the door, both frozen in fear.

shots.scene_setting: The girl stands at the far end of the hallway, flashlight beam trembling across the peeling wallpaper. The man is just visible behind her, halfway out of his bedroom, frozen mid-step.
shots.primary_action: The girl hesitates, breathing shallowly, eyes locked on the closed door at the end of the hall.

shots.scene_setting: Close-up on the girl’s face — sweat beads on her forehead, lips parted in dread. The man’s hand enters frame, gripping her shoulder from behind.
shots.primary_action: The man tries to pull her back, but she resists, staring ahead with unblinking terror.

shots.scene_setting: The man lunges forward, yanking the door open — a gust of cold air rushes out. The girl stumbles back, flashlight beam swinging wildly across the wall.
shots.primary_action: The door bursts open; the girl screams again, louder, as the man recoils.

shots.scene_setting: The girl collapses to her knees, flashlight rolling away. The man stands rigid, staring into the dark room beyond the door, his breath ragged.
shots.primary_action: The girl sobs silently on the floor while the man remains paralyzed, mouth agape.

shots.scene_setting: The girl slowly rises, trembling, and reaches out to touch the man’s arm. He flinches but doesn’t pull away. The hallway remains silent except for their shallow breathing.
shots.primary_action: The girl places a trembling hand on the man’s arm; he slowly turns to face her, eyes hollow with fear.

scene_setting: A handheld vlog-style shot following a young woman in 18th-century European dress as she walks through a sun-dappled garden path lined with stone statues and blooming roses. She stifles a yawn mid-stride, her fan fluttering slightly. In the background, a distant church bell chimes and a child laughs off-screen near a fountain.

subjects.descriptor: A young woman in a silk gown with lace trim, wearing a bonnet and carrying a fan
An unseen child playing near a fountain

primary_action: The woman stifles a yawn while walking through the garden

scene_setting: A realistic 2D animated scene set in a quiet, sunlit living room with soft shadows and minimal clutter. The focus is on a single human subject exhibiting a physiological non-verbal vocalization — specifically, repeated sniffles — with no other audible sound sources implied or present. Visuals are clean and grounded, avoiding any stylized or surreal elements.

subjects.descriptor: A middle-aged woman with tired eyes and slightly flushed cheeks, seated on a sofa, wearing a simple cotton robe

shots.scene_setting: The woman sits on the sofa, eyes half-closed, head tilted slightly down. A faint sniffle escapes her nose. Sunlight streams through the window, casting soft patterns on the floor. Her robe is slightly rumpled, and her fingers rest loosely on her lap. No other objects or sounds are visible or implied.

She lifts her head slightly, eyes opening a fraction, as another sniffle interrupts her stillness. Her fingers twitch briefly. The sunlight shifts slightly, indicating time passing. Her expression remains weary but not distressed.

She leans forward slightly, shoulders hunching, as a louder sniffle breaks the silence. Her eyes close again, and her hand rises to gently press against her nose. The sunlight now casts longer shadows, suggesting late afternoon.
shots.primary_action: Sniffles more audibly, hand presses nose

shots.scene_setting: She leans back, exhaling slowly, eyes still closed. A final soft sniffle fades as she settles into stillness. The room is quiet, the light now golden and dimming. Her posture relaxes slightly, suggesting a moment of calm after the brief disruption.
shots.primary_action: Sniffles once more, then exhales and relaxes

scene_setting: A dimly lit, realistic 3D-rendered living room with a leather sofa, wooden coffee table, and a large window showing a rainy evening outside. A woman in her 30s (visible, facing camera) sits on the sofa, her face contorted in a smirk-laugh; behind her, a man in his 20s (partially visible over shoulder) is coughing violently into his elbow. The sound of rain tapping on glass and distant thunder rumbles underneath.

subjects.descriptor: woman in her 30s, smirking with half-closed eyes, seated on sofa
man in his 20s, coughing into elbow, partially visible behind sofa

text_on_screen.text: You always laugh like that when I sneeze.

scene_setting: A realistic in-engine game scene depicting a tense moment in a modern urban alleyway at dusk — wet pavement reflects streetlights, steam rises from a nearby manhole, distant sirens and muffled crowd chatter audible. The central human subject, visible in all shots, is the only sound source explicitly tied to visual action — their emotional non-verbal vocalizations drive the narrative.

subjects.descriptor: A young adult male athlete in a soaked tracksuit, kneeling on wet pavement, face contorted in triumph

shots.scene_setting: Low-angle tracking shot following S1 as he stumbles into the alley, panting heavily, hands on knees. Rain drips from his hood. Background: blurred storefronts, flickering neon sign, distant footsteps echo.
Tracking close-up from behind as S1 stops, turns toward a graffiti-covered wall, fists clenched. Steam billows from a nearby vent. His shoulders shake slightly as he suppresses emotion.

Tracking medium shot as S1 suddenly throws his head back and lets out a loud, triumphant cheer — arms raised, mouth wide open. Rainwater sprays from his hair. A pigeon flutters away from a fire escape above.
Tracking shot circling S1 as he drops to his knees, still cheering, now pounding the wet pavement with one fist. His face is flushed, eyes closed. A stray cat darts across the alley behind him.

Tracking wide shot pulling back as S1 slowly stands, arms still raised, chest heaving. He smiles broadly, then lets out one final, echoing cheer. Distant sirens grow louder. The alley is now empty except for him.

scene_setting: A gritty, neon-lit alleyway in a dystopian city at night. Flickering LED signs cast pink and green hues over wet concrete. A lone figure in ripped leather and spiked accessories stands center frame, facing the camera with a defiant posture. Behind them, a distant siren wails and a low electronic bass hums beneath — both off-screen sound sources adding to the chaotic urban atmosphere.

subjects.descriptor: A punk vocalist with spiked hair and facial piercings, wearing a studded vest and fingerless gloves, standing confidently under a flickering neon sign.
subjects.primary_action: beatboxing into the camera with rhythmic body jerks and exaggerated facial expressions

primary_action: beatboxing with synchronized facial expressions and body jerks

scene_setting: A dimly lit 19th-century drawing room with velvet drapes, a grandfather clock, and a chandelier casting flickering candlelight; two figures are present, one seated, one standing near the fireplace, both in period attire.

subjects.descriptor: A middle-aged woman in a high-collared Victorian dress, seated on a chaise longue, clutching a handkerchief
A young man in a waistcoat and cravat, standing near the fireplace, holding a letter

shots.scene_setting: The woman sits rigidly on the chaise, eyes fixed on the young man. He reads a letter aloud with a trembling voice. The room is silent except for the ticking clock.
The young man flinches as the woman suddenly bursts into laughter. He drops the letter and sneezes violently, covering his mouth with his handkerchief.
The woman continues laughing, tears streaming down her cheeks. The young man, recovering from his sneeze, begins to whistle a jaunty tune, swaying slightly.
The woman’s laughter subsides into a sigh. The young man stops whistling and stares at her, then smiles. The grandfather clock chimes softly in the background.

scene_setting: A dimly lit, cluttered bedroom in a realistic game environment. Dust motes float in the sliver of moonlight through half-closed blinds. A rumpled duvet covers a sleeping figure on the bed, with only the silhouette of their head and shoulders visible. A low, rhythmic snore fills the room, occasionally punctuated by a soft snort. In the background, faint ambient creaks of old floorboards and the distant hum of a refrigerator add subtle layers to the soundscape.

subjects.descriptor: A middle-aged man sleeping soundly in a rumpled bed

primary_action: snoring

scene_setting: A handheld vlog-style sequence inside a futuristic bio-lab with glowing panels, sterile surfaces, and floating HUDs. The protagonist is visibly stressed, wearing a neural-interface headset and bio-monitoring suit. The only audible sound is the protagonist’s involuntary hiccups — sharp, rhythmic, and slightly metallic-sounding due to the lab’s ambient resonance. No other sounds are present or implied.

subjects.descriptor: A young adult human wearing a sleek bio-monitoring suit with glowing circuitry, visibly stressed, with a neural-interface headset
A lab technician in a reflective silver jumpsuit, holding a diagnostic tablet, watching S1 with concern

shots.scene_setting: Handheld vlog shot inside a sterile sci-fi lab. S1 is pacing nervously, neural headset flickering, as her first hiccup interrupts her monologue. S2 stands in the background, tablet glowing, watching her. The lab’s ambient hum is silent — only the hiccup is audible.

Camera tracks S1 as she stumbles toward a glowing diagnostic station, hiccuping louder. S2 follows, tablet raised. The lab’s walls pulse with soft blue light — no sound except the hiccups. S1’s face is flushed, eyes wide with frustration.

Close-up on S1’s face as she grips the diagnostic panel, hiccuping violently. S2 leans in, murmuring something unheard — only the hiccup is audible. The panel’s HUD flashes red. S1’s eyes water slightly from strain.
S1 collapses onto a lab bench, hiccuping uncontrollably. S2 rushes to her side, tablet scanning. The lab’s lights dim slightly — still silent except for the hiccups. S1’s bio-suit glows erratically.

S1 sits up, hiccuping slowing to a stop. S2 laughs softly — the first non-hiccup sound. The lab’s lights return to normal. S1 smiles weakly, wiping her eyes. The hiccups are gone, but the tension lingers.

scene_setting: A handheld vlog shot inside a cozy, sunlit living room. The camera slowly dollys out from a close-up of a young woman’s face as she suddenly sneezes violently — eyes shut, nose crinkled, head jerking back. Behind her, a cat jumps off the couch and knocks over a glass of water, creating a sharp crash and liquid splash. Ambient bird chirps drift through an open window. The woman’s sneeze is loud and wet, followed by a sniffle and a soft sigh.

subjects.descriptor: a young woman with freckles and messy bun, wearing a white t-shirt

primary_action: sneezing violently

scene_setting: A handheld vlog-style sequence following a young woman outdoors in a park during late afternoon, capturing her spontaneous mimicry sounds and emotional reactions while walking through changing environments — from a quiet path to a crowded plaza, then to a secluded bench, and finally back to the path under golden hour light. The soundscape includes layered ambient city noise, distant laughter, and her own vocalizations.

subjects.descriptor: a 20s female vlogger with curly hair and casual streetwear, holding a phone selfie-stick
a background jogger in red hoodie, partially visible in shot 2

shots.scene_setting: The vlogger walks along a tree-lined park path, sunlight filtering through leaves. She glances at the camera, smiles, then whistles a short tune — cheerful and rhythmic. Birds chirp faintly in the background. Her expression is playful and relaxed.

She turns a corner into a bustling plaza. A jogger in red hoodie runs past behind her. She laughs at something off-camera, then whistles again — this time louder, competing with ambient chatter and footsteps. Her body jerks slightly as she laughs.
shots.primary_action: laughing and whistling amid crowd noise

shots.scene_setting: She sits on a wooden bench under a large oak tree, catching her breath. Suddenly sneezes — loud and unexpected — then immediately whistles again, trying to recover her rhythm. Her facial expression shifts from surprise to amusement. Distant children’s laughter echoes.

She stands up, adjusts her jacket, and walks back along the path as golden hour light bathes the scene. Whistles one last time — softer, melodic, fading out. Her face is calm, content. Leaves rustle gently. No other people visible.
